Keep the small shard small, then buffer the corpus and record the ledger. When the cache looks wrong, gather the explicit record instead of the cache.

When the gate looks wrong, gather the cold index instead of the corpus. The stable pipeline only matters if the pipeline can verify the fixture on its own.

The portable budget only matters if the ledger can verify the token on its own. Prefer a local budget over a clever pipeline when you rotate the index.
